description: Ministry of Education - Order made under section 27(1) Department of Family Medicine - University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under statutory powers (Section 27(1) read with Section 21 and 139) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Peradeniya. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing legislation and university governance structures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
